logline: A solitary young mage travels across a magical world to understand the essence of every elemental path and become one of Elysia's greatest wizards.
protagonist_arc: Magnus grows from an isolated, curious child with weak water magic into a broadly educated and powerful mage whose strength comes from observation, understanding, experimentation, and accumulated knowledge.
ending_state: Magnus becomes master of the Mage Tower, continues its chronicles, studies magic, and protects Elysia after defeating the Enderdragon in Azeroth.
